TIE

Both responses give the correct answer, Friday, 28 February 2025. From 29 February 2024 to 1 March 2025 is 366 days, so 365 days lands on 28 February. Both also correctly note that 365 days is 52 weeks plus 1 day, so Thursday becomes Friday.

The explanations are about equally thin. Response A's reason for the date ("because 2025 is not a leap year") is a bit of a non-sequitur. Response B's is only slightly better organised and just as unelaborated. Both are well under 120 words.
